meaning_en: to cultivate someone or something over time
quote_cn: （投行）里到处都是花钱培养平庸人才的人
example: She nurtured a side project into a real business.
example_cn: 她把一个业余项目慢慢做成了正经生意。
note: 比 raise 更书面。名词 nurture 指教养/培养。

meaning_en: small improvements that accumulate
quote_cn: 这是一门靠边际收益吃饭的生意
example: The company improved margins through marginal gains.
example_cn: 公司靠一点点的边际提升提高了利润率。
note: 衍生 marginal＝边缘的/微小的；也指人口边缘群体（marginalized）。

meaning_en: an unofficial or unfair route into a job
quote: Nothing wrong with the back door.
quote_cn: 走后门没什么不对。
example: He got in through the back door of a family connection.
example_cn: 他靠家族关系走了后门进去。
note: 职场还指「非标准渠道获客」。走正门是 through the front door。

meaning_en: to take a subordinate role
quote: I played third fiddle to two
quote_cn: 我在我母亲生命里那两个大人物面前只能屈居第三
example: She's been playing third fiddle in the partnership.
example_cn: 她在合伙关系里一直当配角。
note: 源自小提琴三把中的第三把（最低音）。

meaning_en: a system where advancement is based on ability
quote: thing to a meritocracy there is.
quote_cn: 这已经是这世上最接近能力至上的东西了
example: The company has a reputation for being a meritocracy.
example_cn: 这家公司以任人唯贤著称。
note: 形容词 meritocratic；讽刺用法指「其实看关系」。

meaning_en: based on; relying on the evidence of
quote: on the strength of my abilities.
quote_cn: 凭我的能力来评判我
example: He was hired on the strength of his internship.
example_cn: 他是凭实习表现被招进来的。
note: 强调「以此为依据」，也可指某个具体事件促成某结果。

meaning_en: a school or candidate a firm does not normally recruit from
quote_cn: 我们不招那儿的学生。
example: Recruiting dropped to zero at the nontarget schools.
example_cn: 非目标学校的招聘归零了。
note: 咨询/投行术语。反义 target school。名词作形容词用。

meaning_en: an onboarding programme for new staff
quote_cn: 你们第三周的入职培训
example: Induction runs for three days.
example_cn: 入职培训为期三天。
note: 英式常用，美式多说 onboarding/orientation。动词 induct=使就职。

meaning_en: to teach someone a doctrine insistently
quote_cn: 准备好被洗脑了吗？
example: They indoctrinated him into the company culture.
example_cn: 他们给他灌输了公司文化。
note: 强贬义，指不加批判的灌输。名词 indoctrination。

meaning_en: still displaying an obvious marker of your background
meaning_cn: 还挂着标签（出身/身份一眼可见）
quote: label on your sleeve there as well?
quote_cn: 你也把袖口的标签留着呢？
example: New hires shouldn't wear their old job on their sleeve.
example_cn: 新人不该把上一份工作的标签随身带着。
note: 字面裁缝留的布标；引申为「一眼看出底细」。

meaning_en: lacking social grace; tacteless
quote_cn: 你有多俗气
example: Saying that out loud was gauche.
example_cn: 把那句话当众说出来很不得体。
note: 读 /ɡoʊʃ/，结尾不发 /k/。名词 gaucherie＝笨拙。

meaning_en: to display something embarrassingly obvious about yourself
meaning_cn: 竖起自己的广告牌（把自己标出来）
quote_cn: 你刚才那举动等于给自己竖了块广告牌
example: Don't erect a billboard around your own weaknesses.
example_cn: 别把自己的弱点举着牌到处走。
note: 比喻用法：主动暴露自己。erect 在这里是竖立。

meaning_en: to promise that someone's word can be trusted
quote_cn: 哪位资深员工为你背书
example: I'll vouch for her with my manager.
example_cn: 我会向经理替她担保。
note: 正式语体。反义 vouch against（说某人坏话）。

meaning_en: Reduction in Force: large-scale redundancies
quote_cn: 就是 Reduction in Force，也就是裁员
example: Every department is anxious before RIF season.
example_cn: 裁员季前每个部门都心惊胆战。
note: 美式委婉说法；英式多用 redundancy / make redundant。拼写没有 U。

meaning_en: ranking above all others in importance
quote_cn: 全球首屈一指的金融服务机构
example: She is the preeminent scholar in the field.
example_cn: 她是该领域最杰出的学者。
note: 正式书面语，日常用 leading / foremost。副词 preeminently。

meaning_en: a personal financial or emotional interest in the outcome
quote: like you have a stake in it.
quote_cn: 就当你自己有份利益在里面那样行事
example: Employees behave differently when they have a stake in it.
example_cn: 当切身利益在里面时，员工表现就不同了。
note: have a stake in＝有份利益在…；at stake＝处于危险中。

meaning_en: too important to be replaced
quote_cn: 让自己变得不可替代。
example: He made himself indispensable to the team.
example_cn: 他让自己成了团队里无可替代的人。
note: 反义 dispensable（可有可无的）；动词 dispense with＝免除。

meaning_en: profitable trading; revenue
quote: We want to get you printing
quote_cn: 我们希望你尽快开始创收
example: She's been printing business since her first quarter.
example_cn: 她入行第一个季度就开始创收了。
note: 投行/交易行话；print money＝轻松赚钱。

meaning_en: to disclose your trades to a supervisor
quote_cn: 别忘了在这儿报单
example: Analysts must talk their book before taking a position.
example_cn: 分析师建仓前必须报备自己的交易。
note: 投行/券商行话：book＝账本/持仓簿。

meaning_en: to fill someone's inbox with unwanted email
quote: Sorry, I didn't want to clog your inbox.
quote_cn: 抱歉，我不想塞满你的收件箱。
example: The alerts clog my inbox every morning.
example_cn: 这些提醒每天早上塞满我的收件箱。
note: 职场抱怨句式：I don't want to add to your plate（不想给你添活）。

meaning_en: low-probability but catastrophic risk
meaning_cn: 尾部风险（小概率巨灾风险）
quote: tail risk work you did for him.
quote_cn: 你给他做的美国尾部风险工作让他印象深刻
example: The model measures tail risk under stress scenarios.
example_cn: 模型衡量压力情景下的尾部风险。
note: 金融术语，指分布末端的极端风险；headline risk 指最坏预期。

meaning_en: to archive a position or record
quote_cn: 归档了。
example: He cycled in his notes after the meeting.
example_cn: 会后他把记录归档了。
note: 会计/金融用语，指把账面结清归档。也可说 cycled out（退出）。
